Features / Quality
🛡️ Quality

Quality built in from the start.
Not discovered at the end.

Automated code reviews, continuous security scanning, proactive bug detection, and AI-generated tests — all running with full awareness of your architecture and business context, at every stage of delivery.

🛡️

Why context changes everything: Generic quality tools flag issues without understanding your system. Brunelly knows your architecture, your data flows, and your constraints — so its reviews, scans, and tests reflect what actually matters in your specific codebase.

🛡️ AI Code Reviews

A senior architect reviewing every PR.
Automatically, every time.

Every pull request gets reviewed by Brunelly's AI against your architecture, coding standards, and quality benchmarks. Issues are caught before they're merged — not discovered in production. Because Brunelly understands your full system, it catches problems that decontextualised tools simply cannot see.

✓
AI reviews every PR — identifies issues, suggests improvements, flags risks
✓
Architecture-aware review — checks code against your established patterns and decisions
✓
Code quality analysis — maintainability, complexity, and best practice adherence
✓
Pattern risk detection — architectural anti-patterns flagged before they compound
✓
Contextual feedback — suggestions grounded in your specific system, not generic rules
🛡️ Security Scanning

Security built into every stage.
Not bolted on at the end.

Brunelly runs continuous automated security scanning with full knowledge of your system architecture and data flows. Vulnerabilities are detected early with severity ratings and actionable remediation guidance — not just a list of CVEs.

✓
Automated vulnerability detection across your full codebase continuously
✓
Severity ratings with remediation guidance tailored to your specific system
✓
Architecture-aware scanning — understands what data is sensitive in your context
✓
GDPR, SOC2, and compliance-relevant findings surfaced with appropriate priority
✓
Integrated into the build flow — security checks happen before code merges, not after
Security Scanning

🛡️ Bug Hunter

Find bugs before your users do.

Brunelly's Bug Hunter proactively scans your branches to find potential bugs before they reach production. Because it understands your system's architecture, data flows, and business logic, it catches issues that generic static analysis tools simply cannot see.

✓
Proactive branch scanning — bugs identified before they hit production
✓
Context-aware detection — understands your data flows and business logic
✓
Functional and non-functional issue detection across code and behaviour
✓
Technical debt tracking — identify where refactoring is needed most urgently
✓
Continuous monitoring — an ongoing watch, not a one-time scan
🛡️ Automated Testing

Tests written against your system.
Not a generic textbook.

Brunelly generates test cases directly from your acceptance criteria, executes them automatically, and tracks coverage back to work items. Because it knows your product context, tests reflect how your software actually behaves — not a standardised checklist.

✓
Generate scripted and exploratory tests from acceptance criteria automatically
✓
Automated test execution with detailed pass/fail reporting per run
✓
Test coverage linked to work items — full traceability from requirement to test result
✓
Test run history — track reliability and identify flaky tests across releases
✓
BDD scenarios generated alongside stories — quality built in from the planning stage
